description: P2-5 Copy/Paste/Duplicate (#40) and P2-1 BOM-Canvas bidirectional link (#46). Two related features bundled: (A) Ctrl+C/V/D zone duplication with 100mm offset, constraint enforcement, and history push. (B) Selecting a BOM line highlights its source zone on the canvas; selecting a canvas zone highlights its BOM lines in the BOM panel.
steps: 1. Add clipboard state to canvasStore.ts: `clipboard: TemplateZone[] | null` (stores deep copies of selected zones for paste). Add actions: `copySelection()`, `pasteClipboard()`, `duplicateSelection()`.
2. Implement copySelection: deep-copy all selectedZoneIds zones into clipboard.

3. Implement pasteClipboard: for each zone in clipboard, create a new zone with 100mm x+y offset, new UUID id, apply constrainToWall and hasOverlap checks (adjust offset if overlap), call projectStore.addZone for each, push history, select the new zones.
4. Implement duplicateSelection: same as copy+paste in one action (Ctrl+D shortcut).
5. Update useKeyboardShortcuts.ts: add Ctrl+C -> copySelection, Ctrl+V -> pasteClipboard, Ctrl+D -> duplicateSelection. All only in DESIGNER mode with non-empty selection.

6. For BOM-Canvas bidirectional link: add `highlightedZoneIds: string[]` and `highlightedBomLineIds: string[]` to canvasStore.ts with setters. These are distinct from selection - they show a visual highlight (glow/pulse) without selecting.
7. Update BomSectionTable.tsx or MasterBomTable.tsx: when a BOM line row is clicked/hovered, call `setHighlightedZoneIds([line.source_zone_id])` on canvasStore. On mouse leave, clear.
8. Update ZonesLayer.tsx: if a zone.id is in highlightedZoneIds, render with a distinct highlight style (e.g., thicker yellow/gold stroke or pulsing border) separate from the selection blue.

9. Update ZonesLayer.tsx click handler: when a zone is clicked (selected), look up bomStore.masterBomLines for lines where source_zone_id === zone.id, call `setHighlightedBomLineIds(matchingLineIds)`.
10. Update BomSectionTable.tsx: highlight rows whose IDs are in canvasStore.highlightedBomLineIds (e.g., gold background).

11. Add tests: frontend/src/canvas/__tests__/copyPaste.test.ts (copy, paste with offset, duplicate, overlap avoidance, history push) and frontend/src/canvas/__tests__/bomCanvasLink.test.ts (bidirectional highlighting).
acceptance_criteria: Ctrl+C copies selected zones to clipboard
Ctrl+V pastes clipboard zones with 100mm offset, constrained to wall, no overlap
Paste pushes a single history entry
BOM line click/hover highlights corresponding zone on canvas
Zone selection highlights corresponding BOM lines in BOM panel
All existing tests pass, new tests pass
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest run
